name: Clean & Clear Glass Cleaner

features.text: Removes dirt, smudges and film from glass without streaking.
Color-coded compliant packaging & VOC Compliant. PERFORMANCE RATING - Concentration - 3

description: A strong, versatile glass cleaner that removes dust, grime, and fingerprints. Also removes smoke or film from glass, mirrors, and chrome. Leaves a clean, clear streak-free surface.
application: 1.) Dilute to a minimum of 14 parts water to 1 part product. 2.) Spray on soiled surface or wipe on with a clean cloth. 3.) Wipe surface with a dry, clean, lint-free cloth or microfiber towel until dry and streak-free.
